老拐爷话音落下！

现场一片寂静，所有人都忍不住朝着相识的人相互对视一眼，眼神中满是惊诧之色，万万没想到，老李家竟然还隐藏了这么大的一件事情啊。

“嘭！”

“哎呦……！”

就在这时，便听到一声惨叫声响起，李青山已经一脚将李大奎踹倒在地上，这一脚势大力沉，李大奎感觉浑身骨头架子都要散架了，狼狈不堪。

“李大奎，你个老瘪犊子给我记住了，你和我爹虽然都还是一个娘的，但不是一个爹，那就不是一个祖宗的，李老奎他爹的祖坟和我们家没有半毛钱关系。”

“老瘪犊子玩意，还敢来坑老子的大鱼，踹死你个王八犊子。”

李青山一边说，一边朝着李大奎身上狠狠踹去，李大奎连滚带爬从地上爬起来，浑身上下满是脚印子，跑起来的时候还一拐一瘸的，便跑便喊道：“救命啊，杀人啦……！”

“哈哈……！”

众人望着李大奎狼狈逃走的身影，忍不住一阵哄笑。

至于李老奎，早就偷偷溜走了，哪里还敢在这里继续丢人现眼，自己媳妇和别的男人生孩子的事情都传开了，自己以后这一张老脸还怎么在村子里混哦。

“爹，李老屯不是我亲爷也不是啥坏事情，否则日后要是病了死了，你不出钱不出力，别人还要戳你脊梁骨，现在好了，病了死了咱们都不用管，现在你有婆娘，有儿子，有儿媳妇，还管这么多干什么，好好养老便是。”

李青山看向李三奎开口安慰道。

“唉！”

“我都一把年纪了，这种事情早就看开了。”

李三奎随意摆了摆手，明显没有将这件事情放在心上，估计自己亲爹都死了也说不定呢！！

而且啊！

青山说得对，自己有婆娘，有儿子，有儿媳妇，说不得日后还能有个孙子，还在乎自己亲爹是谁干什么？

“老拐爷，今天多谢您老人家了，这两条鱼您拎着，都是蒜瓣肉，没刺！”

李青山捡了两条鳜鱼递到老拐爷手中道。

“今天，老拐爷我也是实在看不下去了，才说出来的，李老屯这些年啊，实在是太过分了。”

“你这孩子，我也是从小看着长大的。”

“那就是一个二流子，以后学不了什么好，倒是没想到，这段时间走上正路了，要是你小子还和以前那样，我才懒得管你！”

“这鱼我就收下了。”

老拐爷说罢，拎着鱼拄着拐杖就离开了，至于老拐爷会不会被老李家报复？

嘿，给李老屯十个胆子也不敢。

老拐爷的儿子们牺牲了，但是战友可是不少，人家西石溪村也在看着呢，之前好几次打算把老爷子想要接过去的。

村民则是围在李青山家四周，看着李青山家里忙活着。

就感觉杀鱼，处理这么多鱼比较新鲜，比较有趣，否则回家也没啥事干，不如在这里聊聊天，消化一下老李家的丑闻呢！

The old man finished speaking!

The scene was silent, and everyone couldn't help but look at each other at the people they knew. Their eyes were full of surprise. They never expected that the old Li family would hide such a big thing.

"Bang!"

"Ouch...!"

At this moment, a scream was heard, and Li Qingshan kicked Li Dakui to the ground. The kick was so powerful that Li Dakui felt that all the bones in his body were about to fall apart, and he was in a miserable state.

"Li Dakui, you old bastard, remember this. Although you and my father are the same mother, they are not the same father, so they are not the same ancestors. Li Laokui's father's ancestral grave has nothing to do with our family."

"You old bastard, you dare to come and cheat me. I'll kick you to death, you little bastard."

As Li Qingshan spoke, he kicked Li Dakui hard. Li Dakui crawled up from the ground. His body was covered with footprints. He was still limping when he ran. He ran and shouted: "Help, murder...!"

"Haha...!"

Everyone couldn't help bursting into laughter as they looked at Li Dakui's embarrassed escape.

As for Li Laokui, he had sneaked away a long time ago. How dare he continue to embarrass himself here? The news about his wife having children with other men has spread. How can he hang around in the village with such an old face in the future?

"Dad, it's not a bad thing that Li Laotun is not my biological father. Otherwise, if you get sick and die in the future, you won't contribute money or effort, and others will poke your spine. Now that you're better, we don't have to worry about you if you get sick or die. Now you have a mother-in-law, a son, and a daughter-in-law. Why should you care about so many things? Just take good care of yourself."

Li Qingshan looked at Li Sankui and comforted him.

"Alas!"

"I'm old enough to have looked away from this kind of thing a long time ago."

Li Sankui waved his hand casually, obviously not taking this matter to heart. He probably even had his own father dead!!

And ah!

Qingshan is right. He has a mother-in-law, a son, and a daughter-in-law. He may not even have a grandson in the future. Why does he care who his biological father is?

"Old man, thank you very much for today. These two fish you are carrying are all meat with garlic cloves and no spines!"

Li Qingshan picked up two mandarin fish and handed them to Old Guaiye.

"Today, I couldn't bear it anymore, so I said it. Li Laotun has gone too far these past few years."

"I have watched you grow up, kid."

"That's just a second-rate kid. He won't be able to learn anything good in the future. I didn't expect that he has taken the right path during this period. If you are still the same as before, I won't bother to care about you!"

"I will accept this fish."

After saying that, Old Guaiye left with the fish and a cane. As for whether Old Guaiye will be retaliated by the Old Li family?

Hey, even if I give Li Laotun ten courages.

The old man's sons died, but there were many comrades in arms, and Xishixi Village was also watching. They had planned to take the old man over several times before.

The villagers gathered around Li Qingshan's house and watched Li Qingshan's busy life.

I feel like killing fish and handling so many fish is fresher and more interesting. Otherwise, there is nothing to do when I go home. Why not chat here and digest the scandal of Lao Li's family!
